title: Helipro Inc
specs: Uses Robinson R22 and R44 helicopters, popular rotorcraft
Maximum weight per seat including baggage: 200 lbs for R22, 300 lbs for R44

Resident aliens must provide valid green card and passport

blurb: Guests can take an Introductory Flight which includes about 30 minutes of ground school and a 30 or 60-minute flight lesson where they can control the helicopter with instructor guidance. The flight time counts towards a Private Pilot License if training continues. The school offers FAA Part 61 and Part 141 training programs and assists international students with visa processes.
extraNote: No direct financial aid; financing available through partners Pilot Finance and AOPA
